sec.title: September 2 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 603)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **September 2** across gripping Federal Bureau of Investigation crime investigations, satirical Dixieland jazz concerts, public service veteran big band remotes, military recruitment comedies, and society orchestra melodies, Martin Blaine in *The FBI in Peace and War* for Wrigley's Gum (1953, 1956), Henry Levine and Jane Pickens on *The Chamber Music Society of Lower Basin Street* (1950), Ray Anthony on *Here's to Veterans* (1952), *Voice of the Army* (1946), and Leo Reisman on *The Half and Half Show* (1938–1956):
